screens.S_ENTRY: Outside the app: launcher, a .db file opened from another app, a widget tap or update, the sync adapter, or the system starting a component
screens.S_PAYEE: Payee picker (PayeeActivity), opened from a payee field or by another app sending an ACTION_PICK or ACTION_EDIT intent
screens.S_ABOUT_ACTIVITY: About screen (AboutActivity): tab bar with About, Changelog, Credits and Libraries
screens.S_ABOUT_TAB: About tab of the About screen: feedback and logcat links, the Send logcat button and the project links
screens.S_PASSCODE: Passcode screen (PasscodeActivity): digit keys and the backspace key; the fingerprint prompt appears when the device has a fingerprint sensor
screens.S_HELP: Help page (HelpActivity): a WebView showing a help page from a raw file or a URL, opened by another app
screens.S_ACCOUNT_EDIT: Account edit form (AccountEditActivity): account fields, the type and status spinners, the favourite and default toggles, save and cancel
screens.S_ACCOUNT_TRANSACTIONS: Account transaction list (AccountTransactionListFragment): the account header with the balances, the transaction list, the account spinner in the action bar, and the options menu (period, status, filters, add transaction, export to CSV)
screens.S_ACCOUNT_LIST: Account list: AccountListActivity (another app sends PICK or EDIT) or the Accounts screen opened from the navigation drawer; account names, the search box, the + button, and an Edit or Delete menu for each account
screens.S_ACCOUNT_FILTER_DIALOG: Account filter dialog (FilterDialogFragment), opened from the filter item of the account transactions list menu: account name, record count, edit and favourite buttons, OK and Cancel
screens.S_CATEGORY_LIST: Category list (CategoryListFragment): the expandable list of categories and subcategories. Opened to pick a category (ACTION_PICK), each top-level category row shows a selector icon
screens.S_BUDGET_DETAIL: Budget detail (BudgetDetailFragment): the categories and subcategories of one budget, with the budgeted amount, the period, the actual amount and the amount available
screens.S_BUDGET_EDIT: Budget edit (BudgetEditActivity): the budget name, year and month fields, the save icon and the Up arrow in the toolbar, and the year and month pickers
screens.S_BUDGETS: Budgets screen (BudgetsActivity): the budget list (BudgetListFragment) opened from the navigation drawer; tapping a budget row shows its detail, and the Up arrow closes the screen
screens.S_CALCULATOR: Full-screen calculator (CalculatorActivity): the number, operator, delete, clear and equals keys, and the save icon; it returns the entered amount to the caller
screens.S_CURRENCY_EDIT: Currency edit form (CurrencyEditActivity): its fields, and the cancel and done buttons from action_buttons.xml (currency_edit_activity.xml:208; that layout has no toolbar)
screens.S_PASSWORD: Password screen (PasswordActivity): one password field (txtPassword) and the OK button (btnSubmit); it is shown before a database opens
screens.S_CURRENCY_LIST: Currency list (CurrencyListActivity with CurrencyListFragment): the list of currencies, opened from the main menu, from the account editor, or by another app (ACTION_PICK or ACTION_EDIT)
screens.S_HOME: The home screen: MainActivity shows HomeFragment with the account list, the + button, the search action, the account row menu and, when no account exists, the welcome view with Settings and Add account
screens.S_SELECT_DATABASE: The database chooser (SelectDatabaseActivity): the create-database button (createDatabaseButton) and the open-database button (openDatabaseButton); shown when no valid database is set (MainActivity.showPrerequisite) or when a database change fails (MainActivity.changeDatabase)
screens.S_PORTFOLIO: The investment portfolio list (PortfolioFragment, shown in MainActivity by showPortfolioFragment in place of the home content): the stock rows of one investment account, the header row, and the add (floating action) button
screens.S_INVESTMENT_TRANSACTION_EDIT: The investment transaction edit screen (InvestmentTransactionEditActivity): the account, date, stock name, symbol and notes fields, and the number of shares, purchase price, commission and current price fields that open the calculator
screens.S_PRICE_EDIT: The security price editor (PriceEditActivity), opened from the watchlist item context menu (Edit price): the amount field (amountTextView) opens the calculator, the date field (dateTextView) opens a date dialog, the previous and next day buttons change the date, and the save icon in the toolbar (MenuHelper.save) saves the price
screens.S_WATCHLIST: Watchlist screen (WatchlistFragment, shown inside MainActivity for one investment account): the account header with the favourite star, the account spinner in the action bar, the list of watched securities, and the options menu (update prices, export prices, purge history, change provider)
screens.S_RECURRING_TRANSACTION_EDIT: Recurring transaction edit form (RecurringTransactionEditActivity): payment date with the day arrows, the frequency spinner, payments left, the shared transaction controls, save and cancel
screens.S_RECURRING_LIST: Recurring transactions list (RecurringTransactionListActivity with RecurringTransactionListFragment): the scheduled bills and deposits; the only in-app start site is the due-bill notification (grep section 5)
screens.S_CATEGORIES_REPORT: Categories report (CategoriesReportActivity hosts CategoriesReportFragment): totals per category and subcategory for the selected period; the options menu chooses the period, custom dates or the pie chart; a tap on a row opens the search results for that category
screens.S_INCOME_VS_EXPENSES: Income vs. expenses report (IncomeVsExpensesActivity): a list of income, expenses and difference per month with a footer total; the bar chart of the same months is shown beside the list (dual panel) or in place of it (single panel, with back stack)
screens.S_PAYEE_REPORT: Payee report (PayeesReportActivity hosts PayeeReportFragment): total per payee for the selected period with a footer total; the options menu chooses the period, custom dates or the chart (single panel); a tap on a payee row opens the search results for that payee; the pie chart of the same totals is shown beside the list (dual panel) or in place of it (single panel)
screens.S_SEARCH: Search screen (SearchActivity hosts SearchParametersFragment): the form for the search parameters (account, currency, transaction type, status, dates, amounts, payee, category, transaction number, notes); the options menu Reset icon clears the form; the search itself is run by SearchActivity
screens.S_BEHAVIOUR_SETTINGS: Behaviour settings screen (BehaviourSettingsActivity): the preference list from preferences_behaviour.xml, with the repeating transaction check (time picker) and the bank SMS automation preferences
screens.S_BUDGET_SETTINGS: Budget settings screen (BudgetSettingsActivity): the preference list from preferences_budget.xml, shown by BudgetSettingsFragment
screens.S_DATABASE_SETTINGS: Database settings screen (DatabaseSettingsActivity): the database preference list hosted by DatabaseSettingsFragment
screens.S_GENERAL_SETTINGS: General settings screen (GeneralSettingsActivity with GeneralSettingsFragment): application language, theme, default status, default payee and the anonymous usage data switch
screens.S_INVESTMENT_SETTINGS: Investment settings screen (InvestmentSettingsActivity with InvestmentSettingsFragment): asset allocation threshold, quote provider and exchange rate provider
screens.S_LOOK_FEEL: Look and feel settings screen (LookFeelSettingsActivity hosts LookFeelPreferenceFragment): the account visibility, transaction period, font and font size preferences from preferences_look_and_feel.xml
screens.S_PER_DATABASE_SETTINGS: Per-database settings screen (SettingsActivity hosting PerDatabaseFragment, opened from the per-database preference of the settings list): the preference list from preferences_per_database.xml with the user name, date format, base currency, financial year start, and default account
screens.S_SECURITY_SETTINGS: Security settings screen (SecuritySettingsActivity): the security preference list hosted by SecuritySettingsFragment, opened from the passcode preference of the settings list
screens.S_SYNC_SETTINGS: Synchronization settings screen (SyncPreferencesActivity), which hosts SyncPreferenceFragment
screens.S_SETTINGS: Settings list screen (SettingsActivity hosting SettingsFragment): the main settings preference list opened from the drawer menu and the home welcome view, with one entry per settings section (general, look and feel, behaviour, investment, budget, security, database); the per-database entry opens the same activity with PerDatabaseFragment instead (S_PER_DATABASE_SETTINGS)
screens.S_CHECKING_TRANSACTION_EDIT: Transaction edit form (CheckingTransactionEditActivity): account, payee, category, amount, transaction type, status, notes, attachments, split categories, save and cancel
screens.S_SPLIT_CATEGORIES: Split categories form (SplitCategoriesActivity): one row per split with its amount, category, transaction type and notes; the add button; the save icon in the action bar; the invalid amount dialog
screens.S_TUTORIAL: Tutorial screen (TutorialActivity): five swipeable pages (accounts, transactions, global, financial overview, sync), the Skip control and the options menu
